name: Omaski
author: Ty Richards
description: A faithful SkiFree-style skiing game for Omarchy on an authentic PICO-8 screen: a fixed 128x128 pixel grid and the 16 PICO-8 colours, integer-scaled 1:1 in a square window. All-original artwork.

barWidget.description: Ski the endless slope, hit the ramps, and outrun the Abominable Snow Monster
